label: D1 reward-seen, late episode, while policy leans moderately toward a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded): 100% of activations, zero at GO/D2 or unrewarded D1. Within that it is gated by episode time (silent before trial ~30, rising to trial ~85; ep_trial>=40 keeps 99% of mass) and by the model policy at D1: fires when the a1-vs-a2 logit is mildly-to-moderately pro-a1 (choice in [-2, 8)), never when strongly pro-a2 or very confidently pro-a1; also prefers low-to-mid value (<7.5). Hence 76% of mass precedes an a1 choice and 70% when S1 is good. Uses only observed inputs plus the model own value/policy (no future variables). Precision is ~0.5: many rewarded late D1s with similar policy stay silent. From examples, magnitude is largest on a reward that follows an unrewarded trial (surprising reward, e.g. after rare transitions) and decays across consecutive rewarded trials (0.4 -> 0.08 in a reward streak), but a previous-trial-unrewarded predicate alone only captured ~57% of mass.
